title: A kbtail pane in the kbmon-pane mod follows agents beside the chat from one kbtail.py --jsonl process
goal: `kbtail.py --jsonl` prints each line as one JSON object of time, kind, text, depth, label, role and item, redacted as the text lines are; the kbmon-pane mod registers a `kbtail` command that opens a follow pane running one `kbtail.py --jsonl` process through `$.process.spawn`, drawing the newest lines that fit and ending the process when the pane or the session closes

run:
import json, os, random, string, subprocess, sys, tempfile
R = os.getcwd(); T = tempfile.mkdtemp(); C = os.path.join(T, "cfg"); W = os.path.join(T, "wt")
os.makedirs(W)
import uuid
sid = str(uuid.uuid4())
pdir = os.path.join(C, "projects", "-planted-project"); os.makedirs(pdir)
P = os.path.join(pdir, sid + ".jsonl")
secret = "sk-" + "".join(random.SystemRandom().choice(string.ascii_letters + string.digits) for _ in range(40))
base = {"cwd": W, "sessionId": sid, "isSidechain": False, "timestamp": "2026-10-26T10:00:00.000Z"}
def ent(kind, content, **kw):
    return dict(base, type=kind, message={"role": kind, "content": content}, **kw)
def tool(i, name, inp):
    return ent("assistant", [{"type": "tool_use", "id": "toolu_%d" % i, "name": name, "input": inp}])
rows = [ent("user", "planted-prompt-line\nplanted-prompt-second"),
        ent("assistant", [{"type": "thinking", "thinking": "planted-thinking", "signature": "x"}]),
        ent("assistant", [{"type": "text", "text": "planted-assistant-line\nplanted-second-line"}]),
        tool(1, "Bash", {"command": "echo planted-bash " + secret + " " + "x" * 300}),
        ent("user", [{"type": "tool_result", "tool_use_id": "toolu_1", "is_error": True, "content": "\n  planted-error-line\nmore"}]),
        tool(2, "Read", {"file_path": os.path.join(W, "kb", "_self", "code.md")}),
        {"type": "zz-planted-future", "sessionId": sid}]
with open(P, "w") as f:
    for r in rows:
        f.write(json.dumps(r) + "\n")
    f.write("{not json\n")
before = sorted(os.path.join(d, n) for d, _, ns in os.walk(C) for n in ns)
env = dict(os.environ, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=C, COLUMNS="120", KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite"))
def run(*a):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, *a], cwd=R, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
if not os.path.exists("_tools/kbtail.py"):
    print("check failed: _tools/kbtail.py does not exist"); sys.exit(1)
problems = []
def need(cond, what):
    if not cond:
        problems.append(what)
r = run("_tools/kbtail.py", "--once", "--jsonl", P)
need(r.returncode == 0, "exit %d: %s" % (r.returncode, r.stderr[-300:]))
objs = []
for x in r.stdout.splitlines():
    try:
        objs.append(json.loads(x))
    except ValueError:
        need(False, "a line that is not JSON: " + x[:120])
need(objs and all({"time", "kind", "text", "depth", "label", "role", "item"} <= set(o) for o in objs), "an object without time, kind, text, depth, label, role and item")
texts = " ".join(str(o.get("text")) for o in objs)
need("planted-bash" in texts and "planted-assistant-line" in texts, "the jsonl lines miss the planted entries")
need(secret[-20:] not in r.stdout and "planted-thinking" not in r.stdout, "the jsonl lines show the secret or thinking")
import shutil as _sh
claude = _sh.which("claude")
if claude is None:
    print("check failed: no claude on PATH to validate the mod"); sys.exit(1)
v = subprocess.run([claude, "plugin", "validate", ".claude/skills/kbmon-pane"], cwd=R, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
calls = [x for x in v.stdout.splitlines() if " calls: " in x]
hooks = [x for x in v.stdout.splitlines() if " hooks: " in x]
need(v.returncode == 0, "plugin validate exit %d" % v.returncode)
need(any("$.process.spawn" in x for x in calls), "the mod calls no $.process.spawn: %s" % calls)
need(any("command=kbtail" in x for x in hooks), "the mod handles no kbtail command: %s" % hooks)
print("\n".join(problems) or "ok")
sys.exit(1 if problems else 0)
